implementationGates.pass: Full normalized transcript or real typed incomplete error, no EOT-limit success, CPU/RSS/RTF/p50-p95-p99 and output semantics measured, no regression
implementationGates.fallback: Candidate fails evaluation: retain REVIEW_ONLY; test official Whisper original/whisper.cpp or a legal base/small checkpoint without changing canonical API

implementationGates.name: Host-owned per-invocation OCI Vision isolation
